newsitem.title: USA: Besicorp among those in Nimo pact.
newsitem.headline: Besicorp among those in Nimo pact.

text.p: Besicorp Group Inc said Monday it was one of the 19 independent power producers that reached a tentative agreement with Niagara Mohawk Power Corp to restructure or terminate 44 power purchase contracts.

Besicorp owns interests ranging from 36 to 50 percent in five projects that have contracts with the utility in partnership with affiliates of Kamine Development Corp of Bedminster, N.J. These projects provide a total of 323 megawatts of capacity.
Earlier, the utility said about 2,000 megawatts were involved in the agreement.

Besicorp said it remains optimistic regarding the outcome of these negotiations, but cautions the timing, structure and value of its economic interests are subject to a number of contingencies, the occurrence and outcome of which are impossible to forecast.
The company declined to speculate on the agreement's impact at this time.
